title: Arena
subtitle: Team suggestions that move your plan forward while you clear your daily Arena battles.

purpose.title: Arena team recommendations
purpose.content: Suggested Arena teams built from your selected project, active goals, and roster, so your daily battles also advance your plan.

mode.title: XP or Power
mode.content: XP Mode prefers characters that can still earn XP. Power Mode ignores XP and picks your strongest team. Your choice is remembered.

project.title: Driving project
project.content: Pick which project the Plan team is tuned to. This is the same project selection used on the other Dailies tabs.

teamSize.title: Team size
teamSize.content: Choose 3, 4, or 5 characters for both teams. A full team of 5 is the default; drop to 3 or 4 to concentrate each battle's shared XP on fewer characters. Your choice is remembered.

preferences.title: Preferred trait and damage type
preferences.content: Bias both teams toward a trait or damage type you want to field. It is a soft nudge — the team widens to stay full rather than shrink, and a preference nobody matches is ignored. Your choice is remembered.

plan.title: Plan team
plan.content: One team tuned to your selected project, widening to your other goals and the full roster when it needs more characters. A note shows when it was widened.

locks.title: Lock what you like
locks.content: Lock a character in the Random team and it stays put when you regenerate. Locks reset when you reload.

regenerate.title: Regenerate
regenerate.content: Shuffle a new Random team. Only the unlocked slots change; it is disabled once every slot is locked.
